account.objective: maximize long-term returns while controlling concentration risk

holdings.thesis: Custom silicon (XPU/ASIC) for hyperscaler AI clusters; electro-optical/photonic interconnect roadmap. Revenue inflection driven by Amazon Trainium and Google TPU ramp.
Dominant AI networking franchise (Ethernet switching, custom XPU for Meta and Alphabet) layered on top of a VMware integration that prints free cash flow.
Cheapest AI mega-cap on a P/E basis with proprietary TPU infrastructure, Search monopoly optionality, and a YouTube/Cloud engine that funds it all.
Pure-play AI cluster connectivity — PCIe 5.0/6.0 retimers and CXL switches are critical path for 100k+ GPU rack scale.
Deposition and etch equipment that is unavoidable at every advanced node below 3nm. AI-driven demand for leading-edge logic and HBM DRAM creates a multi-year equipment supercycle.
Largest US nuclear fleet operator at a moment when data centers are signing decade-long carbon-free PPAs at premium rates.
EUV lithography monopoly — no path to advanced logic or DRAM below 7nm without ASML. High-NA EUV extends the moat for another decade.
800G and 1.6T optical transceivers are the bandwidth bottleneck inside every AI cluster. COHR is ramping silicon photonics at a time when competitors are capacity-constrained.
Electrical grid infrastructure play — switchgear, connectors, and power quality products riding the data center and transmission build-out.
Dominant Chinese internet platform trading at a discount — WeChat ecosystem stickiness is near-impossible to replicate, and gaming/fintech optionality is substantial.
Only DOE-licensed domestic uranium enrichment facility in the US; strategic moat in a post-Ukraine supply chain that governments are actively trying to decouple from Russia.
NVIDIA-backed GPU cloud at scale — CoreWeave has committed capacity that hyperscalers could not build fast enough. AI training demand is backlogged years out.
Aerospace and defense actuation systems — flight controls, space launch mechanisms, defense program hardware. Recurring revenue from long-duration government programs.
Radiation detection and nuclear measurement services benefiting from the global nuclear renaissance. New build, reactor uprates, and decommissioning all drive demand.
Domestic uranium producer with a rare earth byproduct stream — two strategic commodities in one vehicle.
Retail brokerage platform with crypto, 24-hour trading, and a young user base that will compound AUM over decades.
Solar energy play riding the data center power demand buildout.
High-performance compute and AI infrastructure exposure.
Enterprise RPA platform with a large installed base of automation workflows. AI co-pilot layer adds stickiness.
AI data center and HPC colocation operator; GPU cluster operations for enterprise AI workloads.
Cross-border payment settlement rail with regulatory clarity post-SEC lawsuit. Sized as an asymmetric tail bet.
